Questions

Is the CSV a Pro feature?

No. The full ledger (plans.csv, plans.json) and the price log (changes.json) are free for everyone under CC BY 4.0 on /data. Pro is the watching and the per-scenario alert, not the data.

How often do you check prices?

Every vendor pricing page was last read on 2026-10-31–2026-11-07 (12 of 12); the date sits on every ledger row. Checks run by hand (our check script plus a read of the page), not on a fixed automatic schedule yet, and so far the ledger has been re-read on 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-31. Pro alerts go out by hand after we confirm a change, so they arrive after our next check, not in real time.

What triggers an alert?

A confirmed change on a vendor’s own pricing page that moves the monthly cost of your scenario: a base fee, MAU tier, SSO or SCIM connection fee, org add-on, or a fee that starts on a future date (like Clerk Directory Sync on 2027-01-01).

How do I set my scenario?

After checkout, reply to the Kit receipt with your vendor and plan, monthly users, SSO connections, SCIM customers and org count (or paste your calculator link). We price it with the same engine as the calculator.

Cancel?

Yes, anytime via Kit. Access lasts through the paid period.

Monthly or annual?

Both: $9/mo or $90/yr. You pick on the Kit checkout page.
